pullRequests.title: Release v0.10.0
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: develop
pullRequests.body:
Everything on develop since v0.9.0, for release as v0.10.0.

#115 (chore/release-0.10.0) must merge into develop first, so that this PR carries the version bump and launcher/release-notes/0.10.0.md. Until then it would release as 0.9.0.

Release checklist (from launcher/docs/RELEASING.md)

 Merge #115 (the bump and the notes) into develop.
 Merge this PR into master.
 Tag the merged commit on master and push the tag:
git fetch origin && git checkout master && git pull --ff-only && git tag…

commits.headline: feat: RAC1 online co-op: SDK interface 1.9, the port's play and world calls (#99)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
* feat(sdk): the world under menus, deaths reported, interface 1.9

For a game in a party, a menu no longer stops or empties the world:

  updated under the game's pause menu and its freeze dialogs (the
  hero and the picture stay as the menu left them), so one player's
  menu never stops the others' world. The loader turns it off again
  when the mods are reset.

commits.author: llesieur99

commits.headline: fix(rac1): the level's background colour, and sky textures and export for modding (#108)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
* fix(port): clear rac1 frames to the game's level background colour

The frame was cleared to the sky header's colour from the extraction,
which the game never uses. The game clears to the level settings'
background (SetBackgroundColor, from the view context at +0x23C), so a
packed rc1_background never showed. Read it with the fog colour and
fall back to the extracted colour for programs without one.

commits.headline: fix(port/rac1-ntsc): give FUN_0020db40's places one C, the grid's own (#109)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The NTSC decomp's catalogue folds FUN_0020db40 (the moby grid's block
free, 0x0020DB40) with its level copies, and the port had two C functions
for those places: the grid's own func_0020DB40 (hand/game_moby_grid.c,
which the grid updater calls, on the relocated bitmap) and a carry of
PAL's level copy func_L00_00251A78 as FUN_0020db40 (hand/functional).
hostgen registered both at the executable's place and every level's, and
the runtime warned at each of them and kept the carried copy,…

commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
* fix(rac1-ntsc): pose the held item on the US disc

HandItemUpdate called the stub at 0x1E9480 on NTSC, so a drawn weapon
was left unposed and drew a white dome near Ratchet's feet. item_pose.c
moves to the shared rac1 host C with the US disc's addresses mapped in
rac1_version.h.

* fix(rac1): run the matched C for follow camera, FindMobyByDataId and wrench trail

The host replacements for the follow-camera helper, level 5's

commits.headline: fix(launcher): the development channel follows develop (#111)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: master is only updated by release pull requests now, so its rolling builds trailed develop's work by a release. The development channel now reads launcher-dev-develop: DEV_BRANCH is develop, OpenRAC's own launcher on the development channel always resolves to it (so launchers built from master move over with their next update check), and launcher.yml builds on pushes to develop as well as master. Forks still follow the branch they were built from. The release guide describes the release pull…

commits.headline: fix(port): never draw the world from an unusable camera (#114)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A frame drawn from a camera with a NaN or an infinity, an eye out past
every level, or axes of no length or along one line is a black screen
crossed by a few smeared triangles. set_camera now checks the camera
(usable_camera) and the matrices built from it (usable_view); a refused
one is replaced by the last accepted camera, or no world is drawn before
there was one. The first frame of each run of refused cameras is logged
as a warning with the camera's numbers (a few runs a session), and…

commits.headline: fix(rac1): a co-op figure's glove opens and throws with its hand (#120)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A figure's glove was posed from the figure's hand into a buffer in the
port's statics region, but the renderer reads a moby's keys from main
RAM only, so the address landed in the game's code, no key parsed and
the glove kept its bind pose. The pose now goes into one of the game's
blend slots, taken for the glove's moby with find_or_allocate_id_slot
and held as a blending moby holds one (seq 0xFF, frame the slot) until
the glove goes. The glove's own seq is no longer driven from the…

commits.headline: fix(port): Exit on the NTSC main menu, save overwrite prompt, black loading screens (#121)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
* fix(port): raise the main menu's rows from where the game puts them

The rows kept the place they had when first raised, so a row the game moved after (a switch's
flight) stayed behind, out of sight. A row now takes its own place again whenever the game moved
it, and the height comes from the game's own rows' step.

* refactor(port): drop Exit from the pause menu

Quit Game is enough there. The pause Options page is back to the game's items, Video and the
mods'; the Exit texts, the Cross…

commits.headline: feat(port): optional fresh pad input and low-latency frames (#122)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
* fix(port): the tick reads the pad as it is when it starts

The pads were read once a tick, with the window's events at the end of
the last tick; the next tick read that state after the wait for its time
and the frames drawn between ticks, so the sticks and buttons were up to
a tick old (most at a high frame rate, and with VSync and frames between
ticks the next tick also starts later). Input::refresh_pads reads the
gamepads again (SDL_UpdateGamepads) at the end of program::vsync, just
before…

commits.headline: fix(port): Exit leaves and returns with Options like the game's rows (#124)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
* fix(port): the main menu's extra rows merge into Options and come back out of it

Away from the main menu, Exit (and a mod's row) merges into Options while the game's rows shrink,
then is put out of sight below the screen, past what the frames between ticks blend; back, it stays
out of sight until Options' frame grows into its row and comes out of it. It no longer drifts down
with Options into the footer, nor slides in from the left.

The switch is followed after everything that may ask for…

commits.headline: style(port): lay out two new lines as clang-format does and drop stale getenv exceptions (#125)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
The release PR's Port conventions step failed on two lines in
frontend/geometry.cpp and frontend_geometry_test.cpp that clang-format
lays out differently. rac1's host C no longer reads OPENRAC_ variables,
so its GETENV_EXCEPTIONS entries were stale advisories.

commits.headline: fix(port): Exit and the player's language survive Quit Game (#126)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
* fix(port): the main menu's Exit row comes back after Quit Game

Quit Game reads the boot program back from the disc and the port puts the
executable's data back in its place, the main menu's page with it: the
game's three rows again, the Exit row's slot empty and its frame drawn
without a label. The rows made the first time go back in whenever the main
menu is the game's three rows again.
